## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed its planned imaging activity during May 2025. A total of 434 captures were recorded across the reporting period. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic maintained its scheduled service while accommodating the usual staffing arrangements associated with leave.

The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading activity. No additional operational issues were identified in the information supplied for this report.

## Image quality

Of the 434 captures, 93 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 21.4. The proportion of ungradable images remains an important quality measure, as these captures cannot support a definitive grading outcome. The result should therefore be considered alongside the grading activity reported below.

## Grading

There were 93 referable results during May 2025. The median grading lag was 2. This indicates that the central grading process was completed within a short interval for the reporting period. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading measures provide a summary of service delivery at Market Eye Clinic. The ungradable results and referable results should continue to be monitored through routine reporting, with attention to maintaining image quality and timely grading.
